```yaml
name: Debug Push Permissions

on:
  push:
    branches: ['*']
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read
  security-events: read

jobs:
  debug:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
      BRANCH: ${{ github.ref_name }}
      GITHUB_REF: ${{ github.ref }}
      GITHUB_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
      GITHUB_WORKSPACE: ${{ github.workspace }}
      GITHUB_REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
      GITHUB_EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
      GITHUB_ACTOR: ${{ github.actor }}
      GITHUB_ACTIONS: ${{ github.action }}
      GITHUB_RUN_ID: ${{ github.run_id }}
      GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER: ${{ github.run_number }}
      GITHUB_WORKFLOW: ${{ github.workflow }}
      GITHUB_JOB: ${{ github.job }}
      GITHUB_REF_NAME: ${{ github.ref_name }}
      GITHUB_REF_TYPE: ${{ github.ref_type }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install jq
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y jq

      - name: Log environment details
        run: |
          echo "=== Environment Details ==="
          echo "Node version: $(node -v)"
          echo "NPM version: $(npm -v)"
          echo "Git version: $(git --version)"
          echo "GITHUB_REF: $GITHUB_REF"
          echo "GITHUB_SHA: $GITHUB_SHA"
          echo "GITHUB_WORKSPACE: $GITHUB_WORKSPACE"
          echo "GITHUB_REPOSITORY: $GITHUB_REPOSITORY"
          echo "GITHUB_EVENT_NAME: $GITHUB_EVENT_NAME"
          echo "GITHUB_ACTOR: $GITHUB_ACTOR"
          echo "GITHUB_ACTIONS: $GITHUB_ACTIONS"
          echo "GITHUB_RUN_ID: $GITHUB_RUN_ID"
          echo "GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER: $GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER"
          echo "GITHUB_WORKFLOW: $GITHUB_WORKFLOW"
          echo "GITHUB_JOB: $GITHUB_JOB"
          echo "GITHUB_REF_NAME: $GITHUB_REF_NAME"
          echo "GITHUB_REF_TYPE: $GITHUB_REF_TYPE"

      - name: Check auth status
        run: |
          echo "=== Auth Status ==="
          status=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -H "Authorization: token $GITHUB_TOKEN" https://api.github.com/user)
          echo "HTTP status code: $status"
          if [ "$status" -eq 200 ]; then
            echo "GITHUB_TOKEN is valid."
          else
            echo "GITHUB_TOKEN is not valid."
          fi

      - name: Fetch branch protection rules
        run: |
          echo "=== Branch Protection Rules for $BRANCH ==="
          curl -s -H "Authorization: token $GITHUB_TOKEN" https://api.github.com/repos/$REPO/branches/$BRANCH/protection | jq .
        continue-on-error: true
```
